bodyHtml:
A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

A malicious guest crossed Firecracker's microVM boundary, resolved the live VMM from inside the VM, and took control of a root-run host process—turning a Linux networking flaw into a guest-to-host code-execution primitive.
